title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #20

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The name Al-Fatiha means (1 mark)
   A. The Opening
   B. The Cow
   C. The Victory
   D. The Sincerity

2. What is tajweed? (1 mark)
   A. Giving each letter of the Qur'an its proper pronunciation
   B. A kind of prayer mat
   C. The call to prayer
   D. A type of charity

3. Which surah speaks about Abu Lahab? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Masad
   B. Al-Falaq
   C. Al-Fatiha
   D. An-Nasr

4. What is the Prophet's way of life called? (1 mark)
   A. The Hajj
   B. The Sunnah
   C. The Qibla
   D. The Zakat

5. Who does the hadith in Muslim say is better and more beloved to Allah? (1 mark)
   A. The tall person
   B. The strong believer
   C. The weak believer
   D. The rich person

6. According to the hadith, how many names does Allah have that whoever learns and understands them is rewarded? (1 mark)
   A. Ninety-nine
   B. Twelve
   C. Ten
   D. Forty

7. What is the collection of Allah's most beautiful names called? (1 mark)
   A. Sunnah
   B. Tajweed
   C. Asma'ul Husna
   D. Arkan

8. Which name reminds us that Allah sees us when we are alone? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Malik
   B. As-Salam
   C. Ar-Rahim
   D. Al-Basir

9. Which prophet is remembered for generosity to guests? (1 mark)
   A. Salih
   B. Nuh
   C. Yunus
   D. Ibrahim

10. Eid al-Adha reminds us of the obedience of (1 mark)
   A. Ibrahim and Ismail
   B. Adam and Hawa
   C. Nuh and Lut
   D. Musa and Harun

11. How many prophets are named in the Qur'an, as taught at Grade 4? (1 mark)
   A. Twenty-five
   B. Twelve
   C. Ninety-nine
   D. Forty

12. What is a mutawassitah najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A drink
   B. A heavy najasa
   C. A medium najasa
   D. A light najasa

13. How is a medium najasa cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Remove it and wash with water until colour, smell and taste go
   B. Sprinkle once
   C. Wash seven times with soil
   D. Ignore it

14. What does "twahara" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer
   B. Charity
   C. Purity
   D. Fasting

15. What is the Qibla? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer mat
   B. A call to prayer
   C. A garment
   D. The direction of the Kaaba

16. Which prayer begins at midday after the sun passes its highest point? (1 mark)
   A. Dhuhr
   B. Isha
   C. Maghrib
   D. Fajr

17. What did the Prophet tell the man who prayed in a hurry? (1 mark)
   A. Go back and pray again
   B. Pray faster
   C. Continue
   D. Ignore it

18. What did the Prophet say about learning to pray? (1 mark)
   A. Pray quickly
   B. Pray in any way
   C. Never pray
   D. Pray as you have seen me praying

19. Why should clothes not carry rude words or pictures? (1 mark)
   A. They are heavy
   B. They are cheap
   C. They disrespect faith and others
   D. They fade

20. What should you do if a stranger online asks for your address? (1 mark)
   A. Tell friends
   B. Refuse and tell an adult
   C. Send a photo
   D. Give it

21. How should we give sadaqah? (1 mark)
   A. Loudly to embarrass
   B. With insults
   C. With shame
   D. Quietly and kindly

22. What does the dua for entering the house mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, upon our Lord we depend
   B. Say He is Allah
   C. Guide us
   D. Read in the name

23. What do we say when entering the house? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna
   B. Only Amin
   C. Tawakkaltu 'alallah
   D. Subhanallah

24. What does the Qur'an place right after worshipping Allah in Surah 17:23? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Being kind to parents
   C. Trade
   D. Journey

25. What should we do when a grandparent repeats stories? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh at them
   B. Listen patiently
   C. Leave
   D. Shout

26. Which is a duty to grandparents? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore them
   B. Shout
   C. Avoid
   D. Help them and listen to their stories

27. How can we honour the early converts? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore them
   B. Forget them
   C. Learn their stories and copy their qualities
   D. Insult them

28. Why is it hard to be among the first to believe? (1 mark)
   A. Everyone accepted
   B. Few people believed and many opposed
   C. No one cared
   D. It was easy

29. Who was the first person to believe in the Prophet's message? (1 mark)
   A. Ali
   B. Bilal
   C. Khadija
   D. Abu Bakr

30. What was the Prophet's answer? (1 mark)
   A. He hoped their descendants would worship Allah alone
   B. He said yes
   C. He said nothing
   D. He asked for destruction

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe how a class can show kindness to creatures in the school compound. (4 marks)

32. Why is Abu Bakr called As-Siddiq? (3 marks)

33. Why did the Prophet (S.A.W.) go to Taif? (2 marks)

34. Explain why parents should be fair among their children. (3 marks)

35. In which cave, and near which city, did the first revelation come? (2 marks)

36. Role-play plan: Write a short scene showing a parent fulfilling one obligation and the child's thanks. (5 marks)

37. List the steps of wudhu in order from the hands to the feet. (3 marks)

38. Who were the three earliest converts studied in this lesson? (2 marks)

39. Explain how brushing teeth can be an act of ibadah. (4 marks)

40. Why do Muslims all over the world face the Qibla? (4 marks)

41. Halima made wudhu for Fajr. Later she took a short nap sitting up and then passed wind. Is her wudhu valid? Explain. (4 marks)

42. Give three character traits of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and one way to practise each. (3 marks)

43. Distinguish between physical and spiritual purity. (3 marks)

44. Explain how the greeting "As-salamu alaykum" is connected to a name of Allah. (3 marks)

45. Give the meanings of As-Salam, As-Sami' and Al-Basir. (3 marks)

46. Write the hadith on brushing teeth given in your syllabus. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — The Opening
   Al-Fatiha means "The Opening" because it opens the Qur'an.

2. A — Giving each letter of the Qur'an its proper pronunciation
   Tajweed means reciting the Qur'an with correct rules of pronunciation.

3. A — Al-Masad
   Al-Masad warns Abu Lahab, whose wealth did not save him.

4. B — The Sunnah
   Sunnah means the way of the Prophet.

5. B — The strong believer
   Both have good, but the strong believer is more beloved.

6. A — Ninety-nine
   The hadith speaks of ninety-nine names.

7. C — Asma'ul Husna
   Asma'ul Husna means the Most Beautiful Names.

8. D — Al-Basir
   Al-Basir sees everything.

9. D — Ibrahim
   He served his guests a fattened calf.

10. A — Ibrahim and Ismail
   It remembers the sacrifice of a ram.

11. A — Twenty-five
   Muslims learn twenty-five names.

12. C — A medium najasa
   Mutawassitah means medium.

13. A — Remove it and wash with water until colour, smell and taste go
   Wash until the traces have gone.

14. C — Purity
   Twahara is the Arabic word for purity.

15. D — The direction of the Kaaba
   Muslims face the Kaaba.

16. A — Dhuhr
   Dhuhr begins after the sun passes noon.

17. A — Go back and pray again
   He did not pray properly.

18. D — Pray as you have seen me praying
   Recorded by Al-Bukhari.

19. C — They disrespect faith and others
   Clothes should be modest.

20. B — Refuse and tell an adult
   Strangers can be unsafe.

21. D — Quietly and kindly
   Protect dignity.

22. A — In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, upon our Lord we depend
   That is the meaning.

23. A — Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna
   This is the dua for entering.

24. B — Being kind to parents
   Kindness to parents is very important.

25. B — Listen patiently
   Patience with the old.

26. D — Help them and listen to their stories
   Respect elders.

27. C — Learn their stories and copy their qualities
   Imitate their good deeds.

28. B — Few people believed and many opposed
   The first believers faced hardship.

29. C — Khadija
   Khadija was first.

30. A — He hoped their descendants would worship Allah alone
   He chose mercy.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant and water trees, put out water for birds, keep the compound clean, do not harm insects and animals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid action.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: He believed the Prophet at once and spoke the truth, so he is called the truthful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for believing, 1 mark for truthfulness, 1 mark for title meaning.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: To invite the people of Taif to Islam after losing Khadija and Abu Talib.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for inviting and 1 mark for the reason.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Prophet told parents to fear Allah and be fair among children. Favouring one causes jealousy and hurt.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the teaching, 1 mark for jealousy, 1 mark for fairness.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cave of Hira near Makkah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the cave and 1 mark for the city.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: A parent helps with homework and the child says thank you and promises to do well. Award for a clear obligation, a clear action and an expression of thanks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the obligation, 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for thanks, 2 marks for clarity.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hands, mouth, nose, face, arms to elbows, wipe head and ears, feet to ankles.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each three steps in the right order.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: Khadija, Ali and Abu Bakr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two names and 1 mark for the third.

39. (4 marks)
   Answer: Brush with the intention of following the Sunnah, and to keep clean for prayer. Allah rewards good intentions. We keep the body pure and please Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for intention, 1 mark for following the Sunnah, 1 mark for keeping clean for prayer, 1 mark for reward.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah commanded it in the Qur'an (2:144). It unites Muslims and shows that we worship one Lord.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for command, 1 mark for the verse or Kaaba, 1 mark for unity, 1 mark for one Lord.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: Her nap sitting up did not break wudhu, but passing wind did. So her wudhu is broken and she must make it again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the nap, 1 mark for wind, 1 mark for broken, 1 mark for making wudhu again.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Trustworthy: return borrowed items. Truthful: tell the truth about mistakes. Kind: share your lunch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each trait with a suitable way.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Physical purity is cleaning body, clothes and place from najasaat. Spiritual purity is cleaning the heart from envy, pride and hatred.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for physical, 1 mark for spiritual, 1 mark for an example.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: As-Salam is Allah's name meaning the Source of Peace. The greeting is a prayer for peace and safety.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for As-Salam, 1 mark for meaning of the greeting, 1 mark for the link.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: As-Salam: the Source of Peace; As-Sami': the All-Hearing; Al-Basir: the All-Seeing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Brushing of teeth is a means of purification of the mouth and pleases Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for purification and 1 mark for pleasing Allah.
